units.title: Unit 1: Introduction to Operating Systems
units.summary: What an operating system is and its basic roles.

exercises.q: Define in one sentence what an OS is.
exercises.a: Software that manages hardware resources and provides services to programs.

exercises.q: What is the kernel's main role?
exercises.explain: The kernel manages processes, memory and low-level hardware access.

topics.title: 1.1 Definition and concept
topics.content: An operating system (OS) is the software that manages hardware and provides services to applications.

topics.title: 1.2 Main components
topics.content: Processes, memory, I/O and file systems. Below is a subtopic.

topics.title: 1.2.1 Kernel
topics.content: The kernel is the central part of the OS: it manages processes, memory and device access.

exercises.a: Global connectivity and access to information.

topics.title: 1.1 Impact of Telecommunications
topics.content: Enable long-distance information exchange, real-time services, and economic transformation.

topics.title: 1.2 Components: Transmitter, Receiver, Media
topics.content: The transmitter generates the signal, the receiver captures it; media can be guided (copper, fiber) or unguided (wireless).

topics.title: 1.2.1 Codes and Protocols
topics.content: Codes encode information into signals; protocols define the rules of communication (e.g. HDLC, TCP/IP).
